name: sf-org-health-checker
description: Read-only Salesforce org health checks: security, org limits, Apex code, automation, licenses and unused components.
long_description: Ask Claude to health check any Salesforce org you are logged in to with the Salesforce CLI (sf). You get a scored report with findings and fixes covering the Security Health Check score and risky settings, admin users, org limits and storage, Apex test coverage, Process Builder and Workflow Rule migration, flows, license usage, and unused reports, profiles, permission sets and queues. Every check is read-only and runs on your computer. Requires the Salesforce CLI, logged in with `sf org login web`.

tools.name: list_orgs
tools.description: List the Salesforce orgs the Salesforce CLI is logged in to

tools.name: full_health_check
tools.description: Run every health check and return a scored report

tools.name: check_security
tools.description: Health Check score, risky settings, admin users, dormant users

tools.name: check_limits
tools.description: Storage, API and other org limits at 75% or more

tools.name: check_code
tools.description: Apex coverage, old API versions, multiple triggers, failed async jobs

tools.name: check_automation
tools.description: Process Builder, Workflow Rules, inactive and crowded flows

tools.name: check_licenses
tools.description: Full, under-used and expiring licenses, frozen users

tools.name: check_unused
